\version "2.24.3"

\header {
  title = "Klavierstück in B-Dur"
  subtitle = "im Stil Mozarts"
  composer = "ChatGPT"
  tagline = ""
}

global = {
  \key bes \major
  \time 4/4
  \tempo "Allegretto grazioso" 4 = 120
}

right = \relative c'' {
  \global
  \partial 4 f4\p

  % 1–8
  bes4( d8 c bes4 a) |
  g4( f8 g a4 bes) |
  d4( c8 bes a4 g) |
  f2( bes4) r4 |
  d4( c8 bes a4 g) |
  f4( g8 a bes4 c) |
  d4( c8 bes a4 bes) |
  g2( f4) r4 |

  % 9–16
  f4( a8 g f4 es) |
  d4( c8 d es4 f) |
  g4( f8 es d4 c) |
  bes2( d4) r4 |
  es4( g8 f es4 d) |
  c4( bes8 c d4 es) |
  f4( es8 d c4 d) |
  bes2( a4) r4 |

  % 17–24
  d8( es f g) a4( bes) |
  f8( g a bes) c4( d) |
  bes8( a g f) es4( d) |
  c2\trill bes4 r4 |
  d8( es f g) a4( bes) |
  c8( bes a g) f4( es) |
  d4( c8 bes a4 bes) |
  bes1\fermata
}

left = \relative c {
  \global
  \partial 4 bes4\p

  % 1–8
  bes,4 f' d bes |
  es,4 bes' g es |
  f,4 c' a f |
  bes,4 f' d bes |
  g,4 d' bes g |
  c,4 g' es c |
  f,4 c' a f |
  bes,4 f' d bes |

  % 9–16
  bes,4 f' d bes |
  es,4 bes' g es |
  f,4 c' a f |
  bes,4 f' d bes |
  es,4 bes' g es |
  a,4 e' cis a |
  d,4 a' f d |
  g,4 d' bes g |

  % 17–24
  c,4 g' es c |
  f,4 c' a f |
  bes,4 f' d bes |
  es,4 bes' g es |
  f,4 c' a f |
  g,4 d' bes g |
  c,4 g' es c |
  bes,1\fermata
}

dynamics = {
  s4\p
  s1*3
  s1\< 
  s1
  s1\!
  s1\mf
  s1
  s1
  s1\p
  s1
  s1\< 
  s1
  s1\!
  s1\mf
  s1
  s1
  s1\<
  s1
  s1
  s1\!
  s1\f
  s1
  s1
  s1\>
  s1\p
}

pedal = {
  s4
  s1*7
  s1\sustainOn
  s1
  s1\sustainOff
  s1*5
  s1\sustainOn
  s1
  s1\sustainOff
  s1*4
  s1\sustainOn
  s1
  s1\sustainOff
  s1*2
}

\score {
  \new PianoStaff <<
    \new Staff = "RH" \with { midiInstrument = "acoustic grand" } { \clef treble \right }
    \new Dynamics { \dynamics }
    \new Staff = "LH" \with { midiInstrument = "acoustic grand" } { \clef bass \left }
    \new Dynamics { \pedal }
  >>
  \layout { }
  \midi { }
}
